card.title: 59. PANZERGRENADIER
card.text: 59. Panzergrenadier can move and attack during the same turn.
card.flavorText: Panzergrenadier is a German term for a motorized or mechanized infantryman and a term that was first adopted in 1942. The Panzergrenadier Divisions were combined arms formations, usually with two or three regiments of truck-mounted infantry, a battalion of tanks, artillery support, reconnaissance units, combat engineers, anti-tank and anti-aircraft artillery, etc. The 59th Panzergrenadier Regiment was attached to the 20th Panzer Division of the Whermacht which fought on the Eastern Front and took part in the battles of Moscow and Kursk. They surrendered with their division to the US and Soviet forces in Czechoslovakia in May 1945.
